meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 它能用 Vercel 命令行把网页应用部署上线，并管理 Vercel 上的项目、域名和环境变量。部署前会先本地构建，部署后会用请求确认网址能打开，才把链接发给你。
howto.when: 当你说要“部署”或“发布”网页应用，或要求管理 Vercel 上的项目等资源时触发。

say.text: 帮我把当前项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
say.note: 会先跑构建，成功后上线并检查 URL。

say.text: 查看我 Vercel 上最近的部署记录。
say.note: 会运行 vercel ls 列出近期部署。

say.text: 给生产环境添加环境变量 MY_KEY，值为 abc123。
say.note: 会用管道方式写入，避免交互提示。

howto.what_en: Claude can deploy web apps to Vercel via CLI and manage Vercel projects, domains, and env vars. It builds locally before deploying, then checks the live URL responds before sharing it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to deploy or publish a web app, or manage Vercel projects and related resources.

say_en.text: Deploy the current project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: It will build, deploy, and verify the live URL.

say_en.text: Add an env var MY_KEY with value abc123 to production.
say_en.note: Uses echo piping to avoid interactive prompts.
